reader_notes: Gaps (1) and (2) sit close together in the opening two sentences, so the reader has to hold two blanks before any context has accumulated; both are still uniquely determined by the sentence they sit in.

Gap (5)'s option set is a near-homophone cluster (eligible / illegible / negligible / legible). It is solvable, and the 'read the shape of a line' metaphor earlier in the passage supports 'legible' properly, but it rewards careful eyes more than vocabulary depth.
